LanguageData.MF_Settings_NoResults: No matching settings. Try another word.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_AutoCaptureHelp: Automatically photograph selected events or suggest a birthday photograph. Manual photographs and group gatherings remain available when this is off.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_AutoDisabled: Automatic photographs are off. Your selections are kept and will apply when you turn them on again.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_PresetImportantHint: Major events and milestones. Birthdays every 5 years; the first battle of each type.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_PresetNormalHint: Focus on events. Birthdays every 2 years; first and difficult battles.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_PresetRichHint: The original default. Yearly birthdays, plus parties, sky phenomena and legendary crafting.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_PresetHelp: Changes only automatic event selections and intervals. Birthday mode and companions, effects, appearance, memories and storage stay selected.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_BirthdayDisabled: Enable birthday photographs to use this setting.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_RecruitDisabled: Enable recruitment photographs to use this setting.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_FadeDisabled: Enable frame fading to use this setting.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_RitualDisabled: Applies when religious ritual photographs are enabled.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_PreviewBody: The days we shared, one photograph at a time.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_FramingTitle: How much should fit in the frame?
LanguageData.MF_Settings_FramingNote: An illustration of framing. A larger click span includes more of the surroundings. Drag photographs use the area you select.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_NightOn: On · make people easier to see
LanguageData.MF_Settings_NightNote: An illustration of brightness. Applies to new photographs; existing ones stay unchanged. Disasters and sky subjects such as auroras or eclipses keep their original light.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_ReactionsNote: Examples of actual saved photographs. In some photographs, at most three awake colonists react for about a real-time second. Babies, sleeping, downed, drafted, mentally unstable or out-of-frame colonists are excluded.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_StorageHint: Changing the photo folder does not move existing photographs.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_PreviewUnavailable: The example photograph could not be loaded.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_PreviewHint: Preview the theme, font and text size here.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_PreviewSample: The days we shared, one photograph at a time.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_FramingHint: A larger click span includes more of the surroundings.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_NightHint: Applies to new photographs. Disasters and sky subjects such as auroras or eclipses keep their original light.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_ReactionsHint: In some photographs, at most three awake colonists react for about a second. Babies, sleeping, downed, drafted, mentally unstable and out-of-frame colonists are excluded.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Hint_capture: Choose the moments to keep, then open their settings when needed.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Hint_photo: Choose framing, image quality and effects at the shutter.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Hint_appearance: Preview themes and fonts, then choose a comfortable text size.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Hint_memories: Choose how colonists share photographs and revisit past moments.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Hint_storage: Choose a photo folder and any additional rituals to exclude.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_birthdayMode: Choose a letter asking where to take a photograph, or an immediate photograph where the colonist is.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_birthdayEvery: Photograph every chosen number of years. The birthday that makes a colonist an adult always counts.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_birthdayFriends: When gathering for a birthday, family, lovers and people with opinion +20 or higher are selected by default.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msBaby: Automatically photograph the arrival of a newborn.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msDeath: Record a colonist death in a photograph.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msRecruitFirstOnly: Limit recruitment photographs to the colony's first recruitment.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msResurrect: Record each colonist's first resurrection once.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msPersonal: Record major surgery mishaps, becoming a sanguophage, xenogerms, persona weapons, high titles and other personal milestones.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_capturePetArrivals: Photograph a newly owned animal with a name, bond or master once.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_captureParties: Photograph parties, celebrations, sky lantern festivals and tree festivals.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_captureRituals: Record trials, executions, conversions, sacrifices, duels and tree connections. Some repeated rituals are excluded.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msRole: Record a leader, moral guide or specialist taking office.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msRelic: Record each ideological relic being placed in a reliquary once.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_battleMode: The first battle of each type is recorded. Later animal packs require new injuries (at least 5 additional injury severity), new bleeding, downing or death during that fight. Other battles can also qualify when enemy numbers reach the colony population. Later hard battles share a 15-day interval; Every battle bypasses these limits.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msMechBoss: Record the defeat of a mechanoid boss.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msDisaster: Take a wide daytime photograph of the colony during a disaster. After the first of each type, at most one is taken per season.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msSky: Photograph colonists outdoors during an aurora, glowing spores or an eclipse.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msMechlink: Record a Biotech mechlink installation once per colonist.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msRareAnimal: Record the first encounter with, or taming of, an alpha thrumbo or insect queen.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msAnomaly: Record the first sight of each strange Anomaly creature or object, and the first entity containment.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msMonolith: Record an Anomaly monolith advancing to a new level.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msJourney: Photograph colonists after they settle into a biome or landmark visited for the first time.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msColonyStart: Take the first photograph after all starting colonists have left their drop pods.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msLegendary: Record an item being crafted at legendary quality.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msShip: Record a ship or gravship launching.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msHistoric: Record colony anniversaries, first population milestones of 10/20/30/50/100 colonists, and the first gravship landing.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msEnding: Record ship countdowns, royal endings, the archonexus, the mechhive core and other ending milestones.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_spanCells: The default span for a single-click photograph. A larger span includes more; drag photographs use the area you select.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_photoFormat: The file type of new photographs. JPG files are about a quarter of the size and look the same at normal zoom. PNG keeps every pixel exactly but takes much more disk space. Photos already taken keep their format.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_pxPerCell: Keep the same framing and choose the resolution of the original. The default is 192 pixels per cell, allowing closer viewing and cropping. Higher values increase capture time, saving time and file size. Each side is capped at 4096 pixels; settlement surveys have a separate resolution setting.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_eventZoom: Adjust automatically framed event photographs. A larger multiplier brings people closer.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_brightPhotos: Save new photographs with daylight brightness. Disasters and sky subjects such as auroras or eclipses keep their original light.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_fxFlash: Briefly flash the screen white when a photograph is taken.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_fxShutter: Play the existing shutter sound when a photograph is taken.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_fxPopup: The new photograph shrinks from the centre of the screen into a temporary card. Click it for a larger view.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_fxFreeze: Hold the game for about half a second at the shutter, without changing the selected game speed. Not during raids or fights.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Label_fxCamera: Move the view to the photograph
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_fxCamera: For automatic event and milestone photographs, move the view to the photographed place and fit the framing.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_captureReactionMode: In some photographs, including birthdays, a few colonists react briefly. By default reactions appear on the map after the shutter; they can also be saved in new photographs.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_albumTheme: Choose the appearance of the album, personal chronicles and year in review. Font and text size stay selected.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_albumFont: Use the theme's default font or choose another font.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_albumTextSize: Choose text size for the album, personal chronicles and year in review.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_albumAppearanceReset: Restore the Pencil watercolor journal theme, theme default font and 100% text size.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_albumTilt: Place album photographs at a slight angle.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_fade: Only photographs displayed in frames on the map fade with age. Original files and the album stay unchanged.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_fadeYears: Years for a plain frame to fade fully. Masterwork and better frames fade at half the speed.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_creditsPhotos: When a game ends, the colony's photos roll on both sides of the credits, oldest first. When the credits stop, a few big moments come back full size and the ending photo closes the show.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_memoryNight: Colonists sometimes gather by a projector in the evening. The manual button remains available.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_projectorSeconds: Real seconds per photograph, independent of game speed. The interval pauses with the game.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_reminisce: Colonists view hung photographs for recreation, and people in the same photograph sometimes reminisce together.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_chronicleTab: Shows the Chronicle tab when you select a person. Turning it off only hides the tab; photos and records are kept.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_lifeEvents: Record moments without photographs, such as joining, romance, bonds, separation, kidnapping and lost limbs, in personal chronicles.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_yearLetter: At the turn of the year, receive a letter looking back on last year's photographs and moments.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_msAnniversaryLetter: Shows the earliest eligible milestone photograph on the same local calendar date exactly one year later. Each photo is used once, at most one letter per day, including after a reload.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Label_journeyRoute: Photographs and journeys on the world map
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_journeyRoute: Connect places colonists have visited and pin photographs at places where they were taken.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_folderOverride: Leave empty for the default folder. Existing photographs are not moved, so changing the folder may make them appear missing.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_Help_ritualExclude: Enter the defNames of rituals not to photograph, separated by commas.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_ZoomHint: A larger event zoom brings people closer. The group determines the base framing.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_RealPhotoExample: Two crops of the same real birthday photograph.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_BrightnessSample: An illustrative brightness comparison of the same photo. Actual night results depend on local lighting.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_ReactionEnlarged: Enlarged around the people to make the reactions visible.
LanguageData.MF_Settings_EnlargeExample: Click a photograph to enlarge it.
